technical_requirements: Workloads: chat-heavy support assistant (mixed short+long prompts) + embeddings for retrieval
Targets: 95ms p50 on short chat turns, p90 < 400ms for typical prompts; tail tolerance up to 800ms
Throughput expectations: steady-state 6-9 QPS, peak simulated 18-22 QPS during load tests
Concurrency observed in trial: up to 14 concurrent generation sessions; expect planning headroom to 20 for 25% growth
Token mix (trial telemetry): avg request tokens 80, avg response tokens 320, ~30% calls were embeddings (short, 128 tokens), 70% generations
SLA & isolation: prefer Dedicated with VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for key material
Retention: 90-day request logs, redact PII by default, ability to turn off logs for EU-only customer slices
